Fistulization into the GI tract via the pancreatic duct (virsungorrhagia) is only presumed and was not directly visualized; it is not recorded as confirmed.

The terminal laboratory values and blood pressure are stated in sentences without their own time; "Eight months after the initial embolization" belongs to the arrest sentence, so these values carry no time. Lipase 118 U/L is timed only by the discussion, which restates the value "at the time of fatal rupture".
